summary: Resolve a job query to the exact-title task template first, never select a Tasker without an hourly rate, and never commit a booking on a date other than the one requested.
reason: Substring matching sent "furniture assembly" to the IKEA template, whose recommendations carry poster_hourly_rate_cents 0, so every price read $0, the cheapest-first sort picked an unpriced Tasker, and the spend cap passed vacuously. The slot picker also fell back to the first open day, which can land inside the late-cancel fee window.
validated_outcome: Live: the Furniture Assembly template returns real rates (about $41/hr base, $47.10 all-in under the CA rule) where the IKEA template returned $0 for every Tasker.
